The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 24. statement: Let (T, B + M) be a gklt pair on a normal compact Kähler space which is globally strongly Q-factorial, and let A ∈ H1,1 BC(T) be its adjoint class. Let f : T → Z be a projective small contraction onto a normal compact Kähler space. Suppose that the classes of all f-vertical curves lie on one ray R ⊂ NA(T), that A · R < 0, and that a global line bundle L satisfies L · R < 0. Then L m≥0 f∗Lm is locally finitely generated. The relative Proj of a sufficiently divisible Veronese is a projective small contraction f+ : T+ → Z, where T+ is compact Kähler and globally strongly Q-factorial. The reflexive transform L+ is a rational line bundle, with a positive power equal to the relatively ample tautological bundle. The transformed boundary and the same b-nef datum define a gklt pair on T+, with relatively Kähler adjoint A+. This is the generalized flip, with the usual strict discrepancy increase at centres in either exceptional locus. Moreover, if t = (A · C)/(L · C) > 0 for an f-vertical curve C, then there is a unique η ∈ H1,1 BC(Z) such that A = t c1(L) + f∗ η, A+ = t c1(L+ ) + (f+ )∗ η. Every class on T has the corresponding forward transport with an actual exceptional-divisor correction. No assertion of surjectivity on Bott–Chern groups is required.
